n.story:
The traditional role of the weaver is undergoing a radical contraction in the industrial sector while simultaneously finding a high-tech renaissance in the artisanal and technical textile spaces. In industrial settings, your role is shifting from a machine operator to a systems overseer. AI-driven computer vision and IoT sensors now handle the constant monitoring of thread counts, tension, and defect detection, tasks that previously required your constant physical presence and manual measurement.

However, for high-end or technical textiles, your role is being amplified by generative design tools. You will use AI to experiment with complex 3D structures and sustainable material combinations that were previously impossible to calculate manually. The physical act of weaving becomes a premium, 'human-certified' craft, while your daily work involves managing the digital twin of the loom and optimizing production parameters through AI-driven material science insights.
